calls.title: Discovery Session: Safe Rollouts v2
calls.summary: The focus of the meeting was on improving the safe rollout process by integrating automated ramp schedules with monitoring. Kevin Gerami highlighted issues with abrupt rollouts causing incidents and the need for automatic rollback triggers. Bryce Fitzsimons described GrowthBook's approach utilizing A/B tests and guardrails for safer rollouts, while acknowledging the need for faster signal-driven rollups. Developers expressed challenges in defining monitoring parameters without adding complexity. Discussions centered on flexibility in ramp targets and current systems’ limitations in managing configurations across various groups and regions. The team emphasized the importance of a user-friendly UI for ramp scheduling and cautioned against unnecessary complexity in system design, concluding with a commitment to iterative improvements and gathering feedback.
calls.keywords: safe rollout, ramp schedules, rollout orchestration, feature targeting, config changes, SDK payload
